purpose: Refines V2-P00 leakage_audit.json §L3 with a scoped verdict, and re-confirms L1/L2/L4/L5/L6 under the same evidence set. This document supersedes only the L3 wording; V2-P00 evidence is otherwise unchanged.

clean_baseline_reference.worktree_location_note: Verified in a detached git worktree under the session scratchpad; the worktree was created non-destructively and does not touch the operator's working tree.

L1_prompt_leakage.evidence: src/t2s/solver/prompt_builder.py reads only QueryRequest + GroundingContext; Guard 6 prompt hygiene passes; no benchmark identifiers in prompts/direct_sql/*.md.

L2_runtime_logic_leakage.evidence: Guards 1, 2, 8, 11 all pass on both the clean tracked baseline and the current workspace after the R3 rename removed the 'P1' docstring literal.

L3_metadata_leakage.note: Split into two scoped verdicts per V2-P00R §8 to prevent misreading the overall verdict as certification of the OpenMetadata code path.

L3_ACTIVE_BASELINE.scope: Default metadata path exercised by the V2-P00 baseline: StaticMetadataProvider fed by benchmarks/t2s/databases/... and configs/runtime/*.json. Only tracked catalog DTOs (CatalogTable, columns, relationships) are accepted; Guard 5 (gold field isolation) rejects gold_sql/gold_answer/expected_sql/expected_result/reference_sql/ground_truth/execution_score/correctness/gold_tables/gold_columns.

L3_OPENMETADATA_PATH.scope: OpenMetadataProvider (src/t2s/catalog/openmetadata_provider.py and src/t2s/integrations/openmetadata/) is disabled by default (settings.metadata_provider default None; explicit 'openmetadata' selection required).
L3_OPENMETADATA_PATH.rationale: V2-P00 and V2-P00R never invoked this code path; certifying it 'clean' would overstate the evidence. Full L3 verification of the OpenMetadata pipeline is scheduled for V2-P01.
L3_OPENMETADATA_PATH.evidence: src/t2s/configuration/settings.py:48 (metadata_provider default None); src/t2s/catalog/metadata_provider_factory.py (routing table). Nothing in V2-P00R exercises live OpenMetadata payload ingestion.

L4_test_leakage.evidence: tests/ use generic synthetic identifiers (customers, orders, departments). The two new V2-P00R tests (test_result_fingerprint.py, test_experimental_profile_isolation.py) also use synthetic fixtures only.

L5_artifact_log_leakage.note: Settings.__repr__ still not overridden; no code path logs the settings object today. Defence-in-depth override remains a HYPOTHESIS remediation for a later phase.

L6_cache_state_leakage.note: runtime_cache in benchmark and P1 runners is keyed by db_id and rebuilt per replicate/arm — a per-replicate invariant, not a per-call cache guarantee. Documented for future maintainers.

protected_holdout_isolation.evidence: V2-P00R did not read the semantic contents of configs/final_holdout/ or benchmarks/t2s/independent_validation/; Guard 6 continues to enforce that no holdout-derived terms appear in prompts. No PROTECTED_DATA_ACCESS_REQUIRED flag was raised.

L3_metadata_leakage_in_v2_p00.previous_wording: PASS with 'OpenMetadataProvider content is UNKNOWN (never exercised in V2-P00) but its schema does not include gold columns.'
L3_metadata_leakage_in_v2_p00.reason: V2-P00R §8: PASS was too broad; scope must distinguish the exercised baseline from the unexercised OpenMetadata path.
